entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How can we help you today?
Hi, I recently received a bike I ordered, and I'm having some issues with it.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you please describe the problem you're experiencing?

Well, the bike arrived a few days ago, and when I was assembling it, I noticed a pretty significant crack in the frame. Also, one of the wheels is really wobbly. It's almost impossible to ride safely.
I understand. A cracked frame and a wobbly wheel are definitely not acceptable. It sounds like there was some shipping damage that we need to address.
Yeah, it's a real bummer. I was really looking forward to riding it.
I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. We want to make things right for you immediately. To resolve this, we'd be happy to issue a full refund for the bike. Would that be acceptable?
That would be great, yes. How do I return the bike?

We'll email you a free label to return the bike to us. Just pack it back in the original box as best as you can, attach the label, and drop it off at your nearest shipping carrier location. There will be no cost to you.
Okay, perfect. That sounds easy enough.
Excellent. You'll receive the free label and refund confirmation within 24 hours. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's everything. Thank you so much for your help!
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business with VeloFit. Have a great day!
